reviews.title: Great case on the larger size
reviews.comment: Excellent case and price. A great case for first time builders with lots of rooms. Just be aware of how big it is.
reviews.author: SumT

reviews.title: Computer case
reviews.comment: This case had a lot of room to build the boards as well as wiring velcro and compartments to make that easier. The vents for cooling are working great to keep everything running well. This was a great choice overall.
reviews.author: Angie

reviews.title: Best value for the money
reviews.comment: I love this Case, It says mid Tower, but it's huge. I have 10 fans installed inside.
reviews.author: Rauf

reviews.title: Super spacious and clean.
reviews.comment: Plenty of room to work and build inside of. Everything is sturdy and feels quality. Appreciate how almost every panel snaps in instead of having to screw in. Recommended if you've got a large GPU and plenty of fans. It can look a little bare if there isn't too much installed.
reviews.author: jheventurina

reviews.title: Great Case
reviews.comment: Case has tons of room and easy to build in. Love the tons of extra screws included.
reviews.author: Beanicicle
